title: Theo and the Drop
author: Marguerite Eriksen
blurb: Sebastian Brightwater, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
